limitsEnabled: Lua::new() (ALL_SAFE libs), sandbox(true), set_interrupt (returns Continue), set_memory_limit(64MiB)
notes: Session = Lua::new() + memory limit + interrupt + global call + sandbox(true); call is registered before sandbox(true) so it sits in the read-only globals.
Host fn is lua.create_function(|lua, Table| -> Table); fields read with Table::get and the reply built with create_table_with_capacity(0, 3), mirroring the C harness's lua_getfield/lua_setfield.
